title: The Stålheart is always building: the next unbought structure shows printed to the bank's share of its price, KIDOU held over a dome, its beam stalled when starved
context: Round 14, the owner's note (2026-11-13): "whenever we are in the base, the Stalheart should be building something, even if unfinished... maybe partial structures... makes it feel like we need to feed it biomass." Since the morning's KIDOU round a dome prints only while KIDOU's tool is over its cell, KIDOU goes home between jobs, and between programme steps (a board step not bought: the bank cannot pay) nothing is built. Branch r14-always-building off 1162ef92.
outcome: src/domain/hungry-build.js (pure, test/hungry-build.mjs): hungerOf(bank, price, cap) = cap x clamp(bank / price) (never 1 before it is bought); priceOfStep(step, tables) = the board card's base price or the dome kind's (src/content/colony.js), times the coming sector's price index, rounded to 10 kg as the board does; nextHungry(steps, ...) = the first board step of the programme, in order (with `prefer`, the steps it picks first: KIDOU's domes once it stands), not done, not bought, not active, whose `when` would hold in the coming sector (idle and home ignored), with a place on the plan and a price; whoShows(step, { ready }) = 'kidou' for a gantry dome once the Stålheart stands, else 'print' (the partial rises in place, no worker sent). Knobs src/content/dome-city.js HUNGRY_BUILD { cap 0.8, every 0.5 s, rising 2 s, fromSector 1, kidouFirst true, cue '{label} · NEEDS {kg} KG OF BIOMASS' }. src/fx/programme-host.js hunger(): when nothing is due (the `ci < 0` path), every `every` s, from sector `fromSector`, it picks the job, draws it, and keeps story.hunger (the harness's programme.colony.hunger); one callout when the job changes and the bank is short. src/fx/gantry-drive.js hunger(step, k, { progress, rising }): a parked KIDOU with k > 0 drives out (same road as a real job), holds its tool over the cell ('hold'), the dome eased at the print's own pace to k of its tool's share (src/fx/base-print.js partial: the same rise as progress without taking programme.print); home() stays true, so the programme starts real jobs as before; start() on the same dome prints on from where the partial stood (the hold's k), on another dome undoes the partial (k 0), drives home, then out to the bought one. src/fx/kidou-rig.js: a `stall` pose (no rise for `rising` s) runs the beam's clock at 0.2 and dims it to 0.45. Non-gantry steps (board, garage, pearl, launcher...) and every step before KIDOU stands: the partial rises in place, and a later Isao order starts at its k (head). Programme finished: idle (nothing shown). td-tab: bank() on an existing line, +0 lines. Programme finished, or before sector 1: nothing shown, KIDOU parked (idle). The --hungry-build probe (scripts/browser-test.mjs) and --dome-print's two stand-counts tolerate the hungry partial.
alternatives: Partial reads finished at a full bank (cap 1): rejected, it would read as built before it is bought; cap 0.8 instead.

KIDOU stays at the hungry job and drives straight from it to a bought one: rejected for the box, the road home first keeps every drive on the grid's roads and the --colony-grid / --dome-print logs (out, print, back) unchanged.
Isao flying out to show a non-KIDOU partial: not done, the partial rises in place with no worker (the fixed Stålheart's printer); cheaper and never competes with his real orders.
evidence: npm test: 353 test programs passed (test/hungry-build.mjs: hungerOf/priceOfStep/nextHungry/whoShows on the content's tables and the drive's hungry job: parked at k 0, out at k 0.5, held, the partial at 0.5 of the tool's share 0.614, stalled after 2 s, fed, taken over in place (printing on from 0.75 x share), given up for NW (W's partial back to 0, home, out to NW)); npm run check passed; npm run architecture: 218 pure-layer modules, td-tab 5,365 lines (+0), long-line budget holds.

--hungry-build (new, source, headless): the grown base's sector 1 culled; first run (before kidouFirst) picked the scoreboard (1500 kg, who 'print') and KIDOU stayed parked, hence kidouFirst. After: bank 1,903-2,239 kg, programme.colony.hunger {step dome-nw, price 3000, k 0.507-0.6, who kidou}; KIDOU phase 'hold' at (-70.2, -67.6) facing [0,-1], reach 0 m, hungry k 0.363 of want 0.367 at the still; nothing bought, nothing active; the cue 'DOME NW · NEEDS 3,000 KG OF BIOMASS'. PASS. Still: KIDOU straddling NW's island, the dome's wire ring rising under its beam.
--colony-grid (source, headless): PASS, 7 stills; KIDOU over SE at reach 0 m, printedBy dome-se kidou+isao share 0.614; SE 285.3 s, NW 387.8 s, the catapult 534.7 s, SOL-88 flies itself 564.7 s.

Not measured: the frame cost of the hold in a headed browser (it poses the rig per tick as the print phase did, one look at the programme every 0.5 s, no new scene pass); --dome-print not re-run after its tolerance edit; the stall beam (0.2 clock, 0.45 dim) not looked at in a headed browser.
